title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode2 Welcome to the Wonder Stage!

meta.Episode: Episode2 — Welcome to the Wonder Stage!

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, well. It's pretty busy even on a normal weekday. Phoenix Wonderland sure is popular.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which makes it a perfect place for my debut as a star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My story will begin today by first passing the audition with ease.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Glowing reviews of my performances will keep the audience seats filled at every show, which will always end with a standing ovation, as my fandom continues to grow!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thus the curtain will rise on the legend of Tsukasa Tenma, epic superstar!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe... Ha ha ha ha ha! Perfection!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Excuse me... Are you here for the job interview?
You're in the wrong place, buddy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What... And where is the right place?

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: The interviews are being held in that building over there. You'll have to go around that way, so it's a bit of a walk...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This can't be happening! I'll be late!
I must make it somehow!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Pardon me for my rudeness unbefitting of a star!
Please accept my late thanks for your kind advice! Well then, I must be on my way!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: What's up with that kid...
Audition Site

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Huff*... *Huff*... I made it...
My legend nearly ended before it even had a chance to begin!

rows.Speaker: Interviewer
rows.Line: We will now begin interviewing the next group of applicants. Please come this way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Coming! Hehe, now I can finally show off my talents!

rows.Speaker: Interviewer
rows.Line: We'll start from the right side. Please begin with a brief introduction.

rows.Speaker: Applicant
rows.Line: Hello. I decided to apply to work at this park because...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (First impressions are everything at job interviews. Go big or go home! I must outshine everyone else right from the very beginning!)

rows.Speaker: Interviewer
rows.Line: Next, please...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My first name is written with the character for ruling, and second with the characters for pegasus. I am Tsukasa Tenma, the soaring pegasus born to rule the showbiz world!

rows.Speaker: Interviewer
rows.Line: What the?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Allow me to take my first steps to stardom on one of your stages, and I shall repay you with a plethora of incredible shows the crowds will fall in love with!
Did someone say “incredible shows”?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I am not merely a star, I am a supernova!
I am the miracle-bringer! And now, I am at your service!

rows.Speaker: Interviewer
rows.Line: Er... Thank you. Next, please...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Hahahahaha! My introduction left them speechless!
I'm guaranteed to pass this interview with flying colors!)
Hehehe☆ Perfect!
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Naturally, I passed the interview!
Success is the only option for the star-to-be that I am!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Next, I will surely be selected for the main role in a major performance. Tickets will sell out at the mere mention of my name!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My fame will only keep snowballing, resulting in an avalanche of offers from the top theater troupes around the country!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fast forward a few years and I'll be a dazzling star standing on the grandest stages of the world! Ha ha ha ha!
Wow. Some weirdo's just loudly talking to himself...

Spring tends to bring out people like that...
I better hurry home to play some games.

Oh ho? That was an unusual fellow.
He went in the direction of the theme park...
Hmm. Perhaps I should head over there too♪

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: New hires were to wait by the main gate... So around here.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: *poke*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! Wh-What do you want?!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: My apologies for startling you. I'm an employee of the park. Am I correct in assuming you are Tsukasa Tenma, starting today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gulp... That deep voice really doesn't match the mascot image... Hold on, he may be a park mascot, but he's my senior here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's me! It's a pleasure to work with you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you know which stage I've been assigned to?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
It is over that way. You can't see it from here.
Please follow me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That must be the newly built Neo Phoenix Rollercoaster? And that would be the renovated Neo Phoenix Castle!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They've built quite a few new attractions over the last few years. Everywhere you look, it's brand spanking new. But, well, it IS one of the best theme parks in the country!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Hehe... I can't wait to see my new stage! If it's also been recently renovated, it will be dazzlingly gorgeous for sure!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Um, are you sure this is the right way?
We've been walking for a while...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: We are almost there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... This place is almost empty, if you don't count the overgrown shrubbery...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? The path continues further?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're seriously going to lead us through that jungle? Oh, it looks like the path opens up into a clearing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is this a...stage? It looks in serious need of repairs. What does it say on the signboard here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Wonder Stage”?
Haaaaaaaaaaaaah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa! What on earth was that?
Something just dropped out of the sky!
Welcome to the Wonder Stage, a place filled with lots of smiles☆
All together, now! One, two, wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?
Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Can you stop now?
Wonder...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, I'll do it! Wonderhoy, wonderhoy, ahoy! Are you satisfied now? Who are you anyway? Where did you drop from?
From up there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Where? Are you out of your mind?! That's, like, two stories high!
Yup! I wanted to give you a surprise welcome, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, it was a surprise, that's for certain.
But how do you know my name?!
Of course I know your name! I invited you here, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm Emu Otori!
Welcome to the fantastic Wonder Stage, a place filled with lots of smiles!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's put on some incredible shows together, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh...? W-Whaaaaaat?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What the heck is going on?!
